description: The Debug Adapter Protocol server OpenMind Studio uses to debug Python. Runs on your Python, portable first.

features.label: Debug adapter
features.missingNote: The adapter is not in this install. Use Repair to reinstall it.

notes: The official debugpy wheel from PyPI (a pure-Python py2.py3-none-any wheel, unpacked as it is; SHA256 from PyPI). Nothing is added to PATH or to your Python: the adapter is started with PYTHONPATH pointing here, only for a debug session.
